text: {"fixed_clause": "Following account deactivation, user records and transaction histories are retained within our archival databases to support long-term trend analysis and historical continuity, provided that the controller must destroy personal data without undue delay once it is no longer necessary for the purpose of collection, unless a legal retention requirement or pending judicial case applies."}

data.fixed_clause: Following account deactivation, user records and transaction histories are retained within our archival databases to support long-term trend analysis and historical continuity, provided that the controller must destroy personal data without undue delay once it is no longer necessary for the purpose of collection, unless a legal retention requirement or pending judicial case applies.
